items.question: How does the "by invitation only" structure work?
items.answer: Applications are open, but engagements are strictly selective. We limit our active client volume to guarantee absolute strategic focus and resource allocation for every framework we build.

items.question: What is the standard timeline for an engagement?
items.answer: Most engagements run between 4 and 8 weeks, depending on scope. We agree on a clear timeline together before any work begins.
